description: The founder's moderation: closes one circle (Close circle) — every member stops seeing its posts at once (New links stop at once; a link already opened stops working within 5 minutes.); each post stays with its author, and nobody is told. In Development it is done at once. In Live (env live) it asks the founder to approve it in their browser — the page names the circle and who made it — and approving it carries it out, once (live_action_status with wait: true reads the outcome). people_graph finds the circle's id. On the founder's Logs, on the creator's page.

note.description: Live only: one line for your human, why
